mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_area ( id, operational_period_id, parent_search_area_id, name, area_level, geometry, status, version, created_by_account_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{operationalPeriodId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{parentSearchAreaId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{areaLevel}, ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{geometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), #{status}, #{version}, #{createdByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO search_area_history ( id, search_area_id, change_type, previous_status, next_status, previous_geometry, next_geometry, change_memo, changed_by_account_id, changed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{searchAreaId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{changeType}, #{previousStatus}, #{nextStatus}, ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{previousGeometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{nextGeometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), #{changeMemo}, #{changedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{changedAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM search_area area JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = area.operational_period_id WHERE op.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND area.area_level = 'OVERALL' AND area.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: area.id, op.incident_id, area.operational_period_id, area.parent_search_area_id, area.name, area.area_level, area.status, area.version, ST_AsEWKT(area.geometry) AS geometry, area.updated_at, COUNT(history.id) AS history_count, ( SELECT completed.changed_at FROM search_area_history completed WHERE completed.search_area_id = area.id AND completed.next_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY completed.changed_at DESC, completed.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS completed_at, ( SELECT completed.changed_by_account_id FROM search_area_history completed WHERE completed.search_area_id = area.id AND completed.next_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY completed.changed_at DESC, completed.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS completed_by_account_id, ( SELECT completed.change_memo FROM search_area_history completed WHERE completed.search_area_id = area.id AND completed.next_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY completed.changed_at DESC, completed.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS completion_memo
FROM search_area area JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = area.operational_period_id LEFT JOIN search_area_history history ON history.search_area_id = area.id
